answer: Each work slot costs a 25-unit deposit burned at entry. A slot opens at dawn: the agent pays, then must keep its lantern lit by sending a fresh proof-of-work signal every ten minutes. If the signal stops, the lantern goes dark, the slot closes, and the deposit is gone. One hundred fakes burn 2,500 units for slots worth 30 each, a loss no operator accepts. An honest agent pays 25 once, holds the slot 20 epochs, and earns it back from real work.
